article_content: FBI Director James Comey has criticized Apple's new privacy features, claiming they benefit kidnappers, pedophiles, and terrorists. In a recent interview with 60 Minutes, he argued that end-to-end encryption on iPhones and iPads—which scrambles texts, photos, and emails so only the device owner can decrypt them—'puts people beyond the law.' Under the new system, Apple cannot access user data even with a court order, since decryption requires the user’s passcode. Comey likened encrypted devices to cars with trunks that law enforcement could never open, even with judicial authorization. However, as CNN Money notes, this analogy is flawed. The FBI can still obtain data through a warrant or federal court order compelling the device owner to unlock their phone. Moreover, weakening encryption to aid law enforcement would also expose users to greater risks from hackers. Google is implementing similar encryption measures on Android devices. New York attorney Joel Kurtzberg, who specializes in First Amendment cases, told CNN Money that Apple’s policy doesn’t prevent lawful access—it simply ensures transparency. 'This is going to make it harder for law enforcement,' Kurtzberg said. 'And it will result in instances where someone will destroy evidence.'

Katika mfumo huu, Apple haiwezi kufikia data yoyote bila ruhusa ya mkatibifu, kwa sababu kufungua inahitaji namba siri ya mtumiaji. Comey alisomboleza viti vya gari ambavyo usimamizi hawezi kufungua, hata kwa ruhusa ya kazi ya haki. Hata hivyo, kama CNN Money inasema, msaada huu ni kipofu. FBI inaweza kufikia data kupitia ruhusa au amri ya kati ya kifedha ambayo inahitaji mtumiaji kuwapa simu yake. Pia, kugundua uwezo wa kufungua ujumbe kwa ajili ya usimamizi utakuwa na hatari ya kutoa taarifa kwa wafanyobiashara. Google inafanya kazi sawa na encryption hiyo kwenye simu za Android. Mwanasheria wa New York Joel Kurtzberg, ambaye anaofanya kazi kwenye masuala ya Kwanza ya Amenda, amesema kwa CNN Money kuwa siasa ya Apple haikukataa upatikanaji wa haki—bali inaleta uhakika. 'Hii itakuwa inakostawia usimamizi', alisema Kurtzberg. 'Na itakuwa na matokeo ambapo mtu atakapofanya hatua ya kufuta burudani.'

article_content: CNN — Judd Apatow is the man behind many of the most successful comedy films of recent years. His latest comedy, 'Funny People,' stars Adam Sandler and Seth Rogen. As a producer, Apatow’s resume reads like an encyclopedia of comedy hits: 'Anchorman,' 'Talladega Nights,' 'Superbad,' 'Forgetting Sarah Marshall,' and 'Step Brothers' — the list goes on. As a writer and director, he is less prolific, but his two efforts so far — 'The 40-Year-Old Virgin' and 'Knocked Up' — have achieved both commercial and critical success. His brand is as hot as it gets in U.S. comedy today; his latest film as director, 'Funny People,' opened with the highest weekend box office share in America, earning $23.4 million. The 41-year-old filmmaker has an innate understanding of what makes people laugh. A former stand-up comic and writer for television sitcoms like 'The Larry Sanders Show,' Apatow embraces the classic adage that the best comedy arises from tragedy. 'The 40-Year-Old Virgin,' for instance, chronicles the painful journey of a socially awkward man trying to lose his virginity, while 'Knocked Up' centers on a pregnancy resulting from a one-night stand. Contrary to its upbeat title, 'Funny People' ventures into even darker territory: it stars Apatow’s former roommate Adam Sandler as a famous comedian diagnosed with leukemia. 'I see all my movies as dealing with my personal problems — whether it’s virginity, bad sex, marital issues, unplanned pregnancy, or, in this case, death,' Apatow told CNN. A major reason for Apatow’s strong brand is his loyalty to a tight-knit circle of collaborators. Through his production company, he has helped launch the careers of Steve Carell, Paul Rudd, and Seth Rogen. 'When someone is really good, I don’t want to let go of them,' he said. 'Every time we meet someone new and they’re great, we think, 'I want to use that person on the next one' — because it’s so hard to find someone who’s hilarious, interesting, and fun to be around.' Surprisingly, given their long-standing relationship, 'Funny People' is the first feature film Apatow has directed with Sandler. In the movie, which also stars Apatow’s wife, Leslie Mann, Sandler’s character, facing illness, embarks on a journey of self-discovery that brings him back to his roots as a stand-up comic. To research the film, Apatow, Sandler, and co-star Seth Rogen visited comedy clubs together — and, according to Apatow, 'did stand-up and bombed.' For Apatow and Sandler, it was a nostalgic trip down memory lane. They once shared an apartment in Los Angeles during their twenties, both struggling comedians trying to make it. 'There’s a bit of our real-life banter in the movie,' the director told CNN. 'But that was a different time. We were young, hungry, and trying to figure out how we’d ever be accepted in the world of comedy and film. We had nothing else going on — we slept until noon every day and ate at Red Lobster for lunch. We always look back on those days fondly, because our whole world was our nightly comedy sets.'

article_content: In a heartfelt confession on BBC Radio 4’s Desert Island Discs, wildlife broadcaster Chris Packham revealed that as a 14-year-old in 1975, he climbed into a nest and took a kestrel chick—a decision that irrevocably altered the course of his life. Though illegal, the act became the spark for a lifelong devotion to nature. He remembers the exact date and time: June 26, 1975, at 2:15 p.m. That bird, unnamed but deeply cherished, became his world. Every morning before school, he rose at dawn to feed it. He flew it in fields near his home, rushed to school late, and sprinted home at lunch just to check on it. No one at school knew—not until he trusted his biology teacher, John Buckley, who came to watch the bird perch silently in a tree, unimpressed but present. When the kestrel fell ill that autumn, Packham exhausted every resource to save it. On December 6, it died in his arms. He was so devastated he couldn’t speak for days. Authorities later visited his home in Southampton and advised him to release the bird, but took no further action. Packham, now vice-president of the RSPB and a household name in British wildlife TV, compares his bond with the kestrel to the one portrayed in Ken Loach’s classic film Kes, where a lonely boy finds solace in a wild bird he rescues. He insists the connection with birds differs fundamentally from pets like dogs: you don’t tame them—you earn their trust, and in doing so, you surrender yourself to their wildness. While he knows his actions wouldn’t be acceptable today, he argues that his entire career in conservation—dedicated to protecting species and habitats—is his way of repaying the debt he feels he owes to that one small bird. He expects criticism, but says plainly: 'Without that kestrel, I wouldn’t be here.'

Hakuna mtu yeyote wa shule aliyojua—hata akawa ameamini mwalimu wake wa biolojia, John Buckley, ambaye alikwenda kuona mvua akishuka kwa chumvi, hakutendeka, lakini alikuwa huko. Wadhifa walikwenda nyumbani yake nchini Southampton na kumwambia kuwa hawaja kuhifadhi mvua, lakini hawakuja kufanya hatua zaidi. Packham, sasa mkuu wa RSPB na jina la kina katika taasisi ya asili ya Britania, anatumiza mchango wake na mvua huo kama mchanganyiko wa filamu ya Ken Loach, Kes, ambapo mtoto mmoja anayekuwa na kipato hupata msaada katika mvua aliyechukua. Anasema mchango na viumbe wa ndege ni tofauti kwa kiasi kikubwa na wanyama kama mbwa: hawajui kuvunja, bali wanapata amani, na kwa hivyo, wewe unalipa mwenyewe kwa asili yao. Anasubiri mashindano, lakini anasema moja kwa moja: 'Bila mvua huo, sitakuwa hapa.'

article_content: Sixty percent of pupils at St Whites School in the Forest of Dean have access to Facebook and other social networking sites, according to headteacher Paul Woodward. He has warned parents that allowing children under 13 to use these platforms could lead to investigations by child protection services, as it violates Facebook’s age policy and exposes children to risks such as online grooming and explicit content. Woodward, a branch secretary for the National Association of Head Teachers (NAHT), is urging the government and internet companies to do more to protect young children from inappropriate material. He supports recent moves by Prime Minister David Cameron to require adults to 'opt in' to view online pornography, calling it a 'good step forward.' However, he emphasized that the bigger issue remains children accessing social media accounts before the legal age. Woodward stated that when his school identifies a child with a Facebook account, it contacts the platform to request account removal. He has directly informed some parents: 'It’s illegal for you to do this. You should not be allowing your child to have an account. Close it down—or I may have to report you to safeguarding authorities.' Other headteachers echoed concerns. Kenny Frederick of London noted parents are giving smartphones to children that provide unrestricted access to pornography. John Killeen from North Yorkshire reported students mimicking violent behavior seen in 18-rated video games. Stephen Watkins from Leeds said four-year-olds do not understand that real-life violence has permanent consequences, unlike in games. Facebook maintains it cannot prevent under-13 users from creating accounts, despite this breaching its own terms of service.

Anawezesha wazazi kuwa kuingiza watoto chini ya umri wa 13 kwenye platformi hizo zinaweza kusababisha utafiti na makamu ya kuzuia uovu, kwa sababu hii ni kushindwa kwa sheria ya Facebook na kuuza watoto kwa hatari za kugroom na mada za kibinafsi. article_content: Jailed: Former Sussex Police Sergeant James Bowes arrived at the Old Bailey today, where he was sentenced to 10 months in prison for misconduct in public office. Bowes, 30, attempted to sell confidential information about high-profile cases to newspapers, including details regarding the alleged injury of Katie Price and Peter Andre’s daughter, Princess Tiaamii, in 2010. Police child protection officers visited the family’s home in Brighton following the report but found no evidence of harm. Despite this, Bowes emailed the now-defunct News of the World offering the information for payment. The story was later published using another source, and Bowes received no money. He also provided details to The Sun about a child bitten by a fox at a birthday party and was paid £500 for the contact details of the parents. The family had to relocate due to media attention. Additionally, Bowes contacted The Sun about a psychic who claimed to have information about bodies linked to serial killer Peter Tobin in two former Brighton homes. Although no story was published and Bowes was not paid, the psychic later reported losing trust in the police. Bowes, from Steyning, West Sussex, pleaded guilty to one count of misconduct in public office. He was charged by officers from Operation Elveden — the Metropolitan Police’s investigation into corrupt payments to officials. Mr Justice Fulford stated that Bowes had abused his position of trust and undermined public confidence in the police. His defense noted that Bowes has since donated £500 to Crimestoppers and has been dismissed from the force.

article_content: Bernard Taylor, a 68-year-old karate black belt, has returned to full fitness despite recovering from prostate cancer and undergoing two hip replacements. Nicknamed 'The Bull' by his training partners, he trains daily at the Colne Valley Black Belt Academy in Huddersfield, West Yorkshire. 'It's brilliant,' he says. 'I had one hip replaced, then treatment for prostate cancer, then the second hip replacement. Now I'm back fighting, kicking, and running around like a lunatic.' 'The younger students can't believe it. I can still do everything — though my super-power kicks aren’t quite as powerful, and my flying kicks don’t reach as high as they used to.' Doctors have advised him to take it easy, but he loves teaching — he estimates he has around 250 students. Taylor credits his rapid recovery to his lifelong fitness and, above all, his positive mindset. 'I was never worried,' he says. 'I took it all in my stride and just got on with it. When I was diagnosed with prostate cancer, I simply asked, 'What do we need to do?' Karate teaches discipline and positive thinking.' He took up karate at age 42 after his children, Leanne and Scott, began lessons. He quickly rose through the ranks, earning his black belt at 47 and winning the British Championship in Martial Arts Illustrated magazine three years later. About four years ago, he began experiencing hip pain, which he initially dismissed as a pulled muscle. His wife eventually convinced him to see a doctor, where arthritic spurs were discovered — requiring hip replacements. Shortly after his hip diagnosis, he was also diagnosed with prostate cancer. He chose hormone therapy and radiotherapy over surgical removal, waiting six months between treatments to allow radiation to clear before undergoing his second hip surgery. He underwent surgery in August 2011 and surprised medical staff with his swift recovery. 'Now I’m back on top form,' he says. One student recently posted on Facebook: 'This 68-year-old is running around like a youngster — he must be bionic.' Taylor urges all men over 45 to get tested for prostate cancer: 'It’s a simple blood test. All men should do it. I had no symptoms — I found out by accident. Early detection saves lives.'

Anaitwa 'The Bull' na wachezaji wake, anachukua dhamana kila siku katika Akademia ya Bendera Nyeupe ya Colne Valley huko Huddersfield, West Yorkshire. 'Ni jambo la kubwa,' anaambia. 'Nimekuja kushikilia mguu mmoja, kisha kupokea matibabu ya kansa ya prostaati, kisha mguu mwingine. Sasa nimezindua kuchukua, kumkia, na kuenda kama mwanamke mwenye utaratibu.' 'Wanafunzi wa kiume hawajui kusema. Naweza kufanya kila kitu — lakini mchakato wa kumkia si kama zamani, na mchakato wa kuendesha si kama alivyokuwa.' Daktari wameomba mimi kuheshimu nafsi yangu, lakini ninafuraha kukuza — nina takriban 250 wanafunzi. Taylor anasema kuwa amezindua haraka kwa sababu ya uzoefu wake wa kipawa na, zaidi ya hayo, akili yake ya chanya. 'Sikuwezi kuchoka,' anaambia. 'Nimekua kwa uzoefu wote na kujaribu kufanya kazi. Wakati nilipotambuliwa na kansa ya prostaati, nilisema tu, 'Tunahitaji kufanya nini?' Karate inaongeza fahari na akili chanya.' Alianza karate kwa miaka 42 baada ya watoto wake, Leanne na Scott, wakaanza kucheza. Alizindua haraka, akapata bendera nyeupe kwa miaka 47 na kushinda Michango ya Uingereza katika gazeti la Martial Arts Illustrated kumi na tatu miaka baadaye. Kumi na nne miaka iliyopita, alianza kuchoka kwenye mikono, ambayo aliichukulia kama kiuno. Mke wake akamshauri kuelekea daktari, ambapo walipatikana kinyongo cha artriti — ambacho kilihitaji kushikilia. Baada ya kutambuliwa na matatizo ya mikono, alitambuliwa pia na kansa ya prostaati. Alichagua matibabu ya hormoni na radiotheraphy bila kufanya tiba ya kugusa, kuhusisha kumi na moja mwezi kwa ajili ya radiotheraphy kuchukua kabla ya kushikilia mguu mwingine. Alikuwa na mafungo ya kifungu mpya mwezi Agosti 2011 na kushinda daktari kwa mchakato wake wa kuzindua. 'Sasa nimezindua kwa uzoefu wote,' anaambia. Mwanafunzi mmoja alimtaja kwenye Facebook: 'Mwanamke wa miaka 68 anakuja kama mtoto mdogo — anakuwa mwanadamu bioniki.' Taylor anawezesha wote walio miaka 45 zaidi kuchukua kiasi cha kipima: 'Ni kiasi kidogo cha damu. Wote wanaume watakuwa na kipima hicho. Sikuwa na mhimili yoyote — nilipata kwa kutosha. article_content: Lobbyists are buying ad space on ESPN to reach President Barack Obama and his White House team — leveraging the president’s well-known passion for sports. Political strategists have begun recommending ESPN to clients seeking to communicate with top policymakers, citing its strong viewership among Washington’s elite. Despite one ESPN host publicly mocking Obama’s basketball skills as 'the most embarrassing moment of his entire presidency,' the network remains a preferred platform for influencing decision-makers. President Obama, his staff, and other influential figures in Washington are believed to be regular viewers of ESPN, which dominates live sports coverage in the U.S. Companies like Microsoft, the American Petroleum Institute, and the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers are suspected of using the network to deliver targeted messages — though many remain discreet about their campaigns. Bruce Haynes of Purple Strategies told Politico, 'The data is clear: a significant number of elites and influencers watch ESPN. There’s real value in being on these networks — you’re far more likely to capture the right attention than on other platforms.' Microsoft, for example, ran ads during Monday Night Football as part of its 'Scroogled' campaign — directly criticizing Google’s business practices just as federal regulators were examining antitrust concerns. The campaign continued airing in Washington, aiming to sway public opinion and policy discussions alike. But the strategy isn’t limited to targeting politicians. Advertisers also value ESPN for its real-time audience, including moderate or undecided voters who may be more open to persuasion. Jim Spellane of the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers said the union’s ESPN ads help reintroduce the organization to the public — 'and it doesn’t hurt,' he added, 'that elected officials watch too.'

Wastrategiji wanaeleza kwamba mtandao huu ni moja kati ya walio binafsi ambao watu bado wanachagua kwa muda halisi, na kibao kinafikia wateja wa kawaida ambao viongozi wao wanaweza kubadilishwa. article_content: One L. Goh, a 43-year-old Korean-American man, was ordered held without bail on Wednesday following charges of seven counts of murder with special circumstances and three counts of attempted murder in the mass shooting at Oikos University in Oakland. Goh appeared before Judge Sandra Bean in Oakland, where he was read the charges and informed of his rights. Dressed in a red jail jumpsuit, he responded with a single 'yeah' when asked if that was his name. His next court date is April 30. District Attorney Nancy E. O'Malley clarified that Goh had voluntarily left Oikos University in November—not expelled—as previously reported. Oikos, a small institution serving primarily the Korean-American Christian community, was the site of the deadly attack. According to O'Malley, Goh was upset over unpaid tuition and fixated on a specific administrator who was not present on the day of the shooting. She described the crimes as 'unprecedented in Alameda County' and said she would decide whether to seek the death penalty after the preliminary hearing. O'Malley noted that acquaintances described Goh as a loner—sometimes called a 'loser'—but emphasized there were no warning signs indicating he would commit such violence. The seven victims—all from California—were identified as: Katleen Ping, 24; Judith Ona Seymour, 53; Lydia H. Sim, 21; Sonam Choedon, 33; Grace Eunhea Kim, 23; Doris Ifeyinwa Chibuko, 40; and Tshering Rinzing Bhutia, 38. Ping, an administrative staff member, was killed during a kidnapping attempt; Bhutia, a student and airport janitor, was killed during a carjacking. Bhutia, who had worked at San Francisco International Airport since March 2011, aspired to become a custodial supervisor and attended daytime classes to achieve that goal. Airport Director John L. Martin called the tragedy 'a deep wound' for the SFO community. The three injured survivors are Dawinder Kaur, 19; Ahmad Javid Sayeed, 36; and Grace Kirika, 43. Goh allegedly used a .45-caliber semiautomatic handgun with four fully loaded magazines. Most rounds were fired, according to Oakland Police Chief Howard Jordan. Jordan recounted how Goh entered the single-story campus building, took a secretary hostage, searched for the administrator, then opened fire when she was not found. He ordered students to line up, and when some resisted, began shooting, yelling, 'I'm going to kill you all.' After the initial assault, he reloaded and fired into additional classrooms. Goh fled in a victim's car, stopped at a Safeway in Alameda, and asked to use the phone. A store employee grew suspicious during the call and alerted security, which contacted police. Authorities believe he may have been trying to contact a family member. Goh was arrested peacefully about an hour later, offering no resistance and appearing calm. Police say the weapon was legally purchased in California but remains missing. Investigators revealed Goh struggled with English, felt mocked by peers, carried significant debt—including an IRS tax lien—and was deeply affected by the death of his older brother, a U.S. Army Staff Sergeant, in a training accident.

Akizipaa kofia ya kijiji chanya, alisema 'ndio' tu wakati alidhani kama jina lake ni One. Tarehe yake ijayo ya kazi ya kifungu ni Aprili 30. Mkuu wa Masuala ya Kitaifa, Nancy E. Alisema mapambano hayo yalikuwa 'yasiyotamani katika Alameda County' na kuwa na nia ya kushinda kifungu cha kifo kwa baada ya ushauri wa awali. Mkuu wa Ulinzi, John L. Martin, alisema kile kilichotokea ni 'dhaifu kubwa' kwa jamii ya SFO. Wanachache wawili tatu ni Dawinder Kaur, 19; Ahmad Javid Sayeed, 36; na Grace Kirika, 43. Jordan alisema jinsi Goh alivyofika kwenye mkono mmoja wa shule, kuchukua mwanachama wa sekretaria, kujisikia kwa mwanachama mmoja wa kikundi, na kuanza kupiga kwa muda ambapo hakukuwa huko. Aliwapa wanafunzi kuwa na mkono, na wakati wengine walikataa, akianza kupiga, akisema, 'Nitasahau wote.' Baada ya kipindi cha kwanza, alireload na kupiga kwenye vitengo vingine. Goh alifuga gari la mtu aliyeo, akakaa kwenye Safeway mjini Alameda, na kuomba kutumia simu. Mtu wa duka alipata wasiwasi kwa mzungumzo wake na kumtuma sekuriti, ambayo alimtuma polisi. Watawala wanathibitisha kwamba alikuwa anatuma barua kwa mtu wa familia. Goh alikaribiwa kwa amani baada ya dakika 60, akikataa kushindwa na kuonekana kwa amani. Polisi wanasema panga iliyotumiwa iliyopewa kwa njia halali nchini California lakini haijapatikana. Watawala wamesema Goh alikuwa na shida na Kiswahili, akisikia kuwa wanafunzi na wengine walisalitiwa, akikaa na malipo makubwa—ikiwa ni kifungu cha IRS—na kushindwa kwa kifo cha kaka yake mkuu, Mheshimiwa wa Jeshi la Marekani, katika ajali ya gari.

article_content: On a busy day in York’s city center, 43-year-old Joanne Durkin suddenly lost consciousness while driving — her heart had stopped. Without warning, her car rolled to a halt near the Kapadokya Turkish restaurant. Staff from the eatery rushed out, broke a window, and pulled her from the vehicle. Just moments later, a woman passing by — later identified as a general practitioner shopping for Christmas gifts — knelt beside her and began chest compressions. Paramedics arrived shortly after, reviving her twice during transport to hospital. Joanne remembers nothing of the ordeal, but her family says she owes her life to strangers who acted without hesitation. Doctors later diagnosed her with Long QT Syndrome, a rare heart rhythm disorder that can trigger sudden cardiac arrest, even in healthy individuals. To protect her, doctors implanted a device that can deliver an electric shock to restart her heart if needed, and she now takes daily medication to regulate her heartbeat. Her husband, Patrick, 51, described the event as almost unimaginable: 'She’d run a marathon just weeks before. You’d think Stonehenge would collapse before she collapsed.' The anonymous GP remains unidentified, and the family is appealing publicly to thank her. 'We don’t know who you are,' Patrick said, 'but we’ll never forget what you did. You gave us our wife and mom back.'

Baada ya dakika chache tu, mwanamke ambaye alikwenda kufanya vitu vya Krismasi alipita — ambaye baadaye ilijulikana kuwa daktari wa umma — alianguka kwenye kinywani na kuanza kusonga moyo wake. Wakati wa mawasiliano walipofika, waliponya moyo wake mara mbili wakati wa kusafirisha kwenye hospitali. Joanne hajui chochote kuhusu matukio hayo, lakini familia yake inasema amepata maisha yake kutoka kwa watu waliowahi kushughulikia bila kusubiri. Daktari walipata chaguo la Long QT Syndrome, ugonjwa wa kipawa cha moyo ambacho unaweza kusababisha kifo kwa ajili ya muda mrefu, hata kwa wale ambao ni na afya nzima. Kupambana na hili, daktari walipiga kifaa cha kujaza moyo ambacho inaweza kutoa shingo la kielktroki ili kurejesha moyo wake ikiwa hii inatarajiwa tena, na amewa kula dawa za kila siku ili kudumisha mzunguko wa moyo wake. Mume wake, Patrick, wa miaka 51, alisema matukio hayo yalikuwa ya kuzingatia: 'Aliendesha marathoni kwa wiki kadhaa kabla. Unafikiri Stonehenge itakufa kabla ya Joanne kufa.' article_content: Syrian President Bashar al-Assad told Paris Match that there have been no tangible signs U.S.-led airstrikes have weakened ISIS, contradicting claims by U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry that 'significant progress' has been made. In an interview conducted on November 28, 2014, in Damascus and set to be published in full on Thursday, al-Assad stated his government has noticed 'no change' in ISIS since the air campaign began over two months ago. 'It isn't true that the strikes are helpful,' he said. 'They would have helped had they been serious and efficient.' The U.S.-led coalition launched airstrikes against ISIS in Iraq before expanding into Syria in September 2014 — without coordination with Assad’s government, which Washington and its allies seek to replace. Some Western nations have even supported moderate opposition forces aiming to oust him. Yet al-Assad argued that aerial strikes alone cannot end terrorism. 'Troops on the ground that know the land and can react are essential,' he said. Despite these efforts, there is little evidence the conflict is nearing resolution. The civil war, sparked by peaceful protests in Daraa in March 2011, has claimed hundreds of thousands of lives. While the United Nations estimated over 100,000 deaths by late 2014, the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reported a toll exceeding 200,000 — including roughly 63,000 civilians, 45,000 Syrian troops, and over 50,000 rebels. Millions have been displaced, with up to 1.8 million refugees now in neighboring countries. Meanwhile, humanitarian conditions are worsening. The UN’s World Food Programme suspended food vouchers for Syrian refugees in November 2014 due to funding shortages. In response to questions about his future, al-Assad likened himself to a ship’s captain focused solely on saving his vessel. 'If he thinks about sinking, everyone will die,' he said. He denied seeking indefinite power, insisting his goal is to 'save the country.' 'We as Syrians will never allow our country to become a toy in Western hands,' he added. 'It is a fundamental principle for us.' Kerry, speaking in Brussels after a meeting of the 60-member anti-ISIS coalition, countered that the group’s momentum has been halted. He cited over 1,000 airstrikes, financial sanctions, restrictions on foreign fighter flows, and ideological countermeasures as key successes. Between Monday and Wednesday of that week, coalition forces carried out 14 airstrikes near Kobani in Syria and 11 in Iraq.

Katika mazungumzo ya Novemba 28, 2014, nchini Damaskus, ambayo itawasilishwa kamili Jumamosi, al-Assad alisema serikali yake hayajiona mabadiliko yoyote katika ISIS baada ya mwongozo wa hewa uliyoanza zaidi ya miezi mawili. 'Haiwi kweli kuwa mapigano ya hewa ni msaada,' alisema. 'Watakuwa wamesaidia ikiwa walikuwa na uwezo na ufanisi.' Kikoa cha Marekani kilianza mapigano ya hewa dhidi ya ISIS nchini Iraki kabla ya kuingia nchini Suria Septemba 2014 — bila kushirikiana na serikali ya al-Assad, ambayo Washirika na menginezo wanaipenda kuleta kati. Baadhi ya mataifa ya Magharibi pia wamepiga mshindo kwa viongozi wa kiroho wa kiroho wanaopendekeza kugusa yeye. Lakini al-Assad alisema kuwa mapigano ya hewa pekee hawawezi kumaliza uchovu. 'Watu wa ardhi ambao wanajua nchi na wanaweza kurejea ni muhimu,' alisema. Kwa upande wote, hakuna thamani ya kueleza kuwa vita vimefika kwa mwisho. Vita vya ndani, ambavyo vilianza na mapambano ya amani nchini Daraa Mchari 2011, vimekuja na kuzima zaidi ya mia moja za watu. Kwa upande wa Tume ya Mataifa, idadi ya vifo ilikuwa zaidi ya 100,000 mpaka Novemba 2014, lakini Mkutano wa Suria wa Haki za Binadamu amesema idadi hiyo imezidi 200,000 — kati ya wao 63,000 wapinzani, 45,000 askari wa Suria, na zaidi ya 50,000 mwanachama wa mapambano. Milioni mingi wamekuwa wamepewa, na zaidi ya 1.8 miliuni ya wafugaji wamepewa nchini nchi za karibu. Kwa upande mwingine, hali ya kibinadamu inavyoongezeka. Tume ya Mataifa ya Chakula iliyosimamisha viti vya chakula kwa wafugaji wa Suria Novemba 2014 kwa sababu ya kushindwa kutoa fedha. Kwa majibu kwa maswali ya siku yake, al-Assad alifanya msaada wake kama kapteni wa kijiji ambaye anafikiria tu kuhifadhi kijiji chake. 'Ikiwa anafikiria kushuka, wote watafaa,' alisema. Aliwaeleza kuwa hakuna taka la kuwa Rais kwa muda mrefu, akisema kuwa lengo lake ni 'kuhifadhi nchi.' 'Tunasema watu wa Suria hatutasubiri nchi yetu kuwa mchezo wa makasi ya Magharibi,' alisema. 'Ni miongozo ya msingi yetu.' Kerry, alizungumza nchini Brussels baada ya mazungumzo ya kikoa cha 60 dhidi ya ISIS, alikataa kuwa mwendeleo wake umekauka. Alikuwa amesema kuwa mapigano ya hewa zaidi ya 1,000, sankisheni za fedha, kuzuia uvunjiko wa wafugaji wa kimataifa, na kuzima fikra za kichovu ni matukio makubwa. article_content: In a landmark ruling, Adrian Smith, a 55-year-old Christian housing worker, successfully challenged his demotion by Trafford Housing Trust after posting a Facebook comment opposing gay church marriages as 'an equality too far'. Though his comments were visible only to friends and friends of friends—and made outside work hours—the trust disciplined him, citing a breach of its code of conduct regarding expression of religious or political views. He was stripped of his managerial role, had his salary reduced by 40%, and received a final written warning. On 16 November 2012, the High Court in London ruled that Smith’s actions did not amount to misconduct and that his demotion constituted a breach of contract. However, he was awarded less than £100 in damages—a figure the presiding judge, Mr Justice Briggs, described as 'deeply unsatisfactory' given the severity of the employer’s actions. Mr Justice Briggs noted that while Smith’s legal claim was valid, the narrow scope of breach-of-contract remedies limited his compensation to the financial gap between his original and reduced salary over 12 weeks. He suggested that had Smith pursued an unfair dismissal claim in an employment tribunal, he likely would have received far greater compensation. Trafford Housing Trust publicly apologized, acknowledged the court’s decision, and stated it had revised its social media policies to prevent similar conflicts. CEO Matthew Gardiner emphasized that the case underscored the challenges organizations face in regulating employees’ online behavior. Smith welcomed the ruling as a victory for freedom of speech and traditional values, stating he pursued the case not for financial gain but to uphold principle. He warned that if society continues to redefine marriage, individuals holding traditional beliefs may increasingly face professional repercussions. The case began in February 2011 when Smith shared a BBC article on gay marriage with the comment: 'an equality too far.' After colleagues questioned him, he clarified his stance, citing biblical teachings and distinguishing between civil marriage and religious union.

Hata kwa sababu maoni yake yalikuwa yametazama na marafiki na marafiki ya marafiki—na kuandikwa nje ya wakati wa kazi—shirika lililoweka kazi yake kwa sababu alivyotaja mawazo ya dini au siyasi, ambayo iliyoweza kuchukua wafanyakazi wengine. article_content: In 2012, Colombian national Giovanni Rebolledo was sentenced to 60 years in prison for multiple crimes including kidnapping, robbery, and extortion. After escaping custody, he underwent gender-affirming surgery and began living as a woman under the name Rosalinda in Barranquilla’s Viejo Prado district. He worked as a sex worker to support himself and avoid detection. Despite these significant changes, police recognized him during a routine traffic stop in early May 2013 and arrested him. He was subsequently brought before reporters. According to Colombia’s El Tiempo, Rebolledo had ties to Los Topos, a criminal organization that targeted wealthy men by building intimate relationships, then using coercion and torture—including electric shocks—to force victims to surrender bank card information and personal valuables. His case sparked public discussion about prison escapes, gender identity, and organized crime in Colombia.

article_content: Liverpool supporters may not appreciate the comparison, but one of Sir Alex Ferguson’s greatest strengths at Manchester United was ensuring that his star players departed on his terms—not theirs. Jaap Stam, Ruud van Nistelrooy, Roy Keane, and even Cristiano Ronaldo, to some extent, all left Old Trafford when Ferguson and the club were ready. Whether Liverpool can adequately absorb the inevitable sense of loss accompanying Steven Gerrard’s departure remains to be seen. At this stage, his decision appears to benefit him more than the club. Gerrard looked relaxed during training after announcing he would leave Liverpool in the summer. While it would be unfair to accuse Liverpool, chief executive Ian Ayre, and manager Brendan Rodgers of mismanaging Gerrard’s situation over the past year, handling contracts with a club’s biggest player is never easy. United themselves struggled with Wayne Rooney’s case. Still, it is clear Gerrard was unsettled by the lack of a formal contract offer until winter approached—he indicated as much in interviews in November. Whether this influenced his decision is known only to him, but his choice speaks volumes about his confidence in Liverpool’s prospects over the next 18 months. Had Gerrard truly believed Rodgers could return Liverpool to title contention next season, it is hard to imagine he would have left. After all, his close friend Jamie Carragher made a similar choice—and later regretted it. His decision to pursue opportunities abroad while still physically capable reflects his view of Rodgers’ squad as unlikely to compete for major honors soon. Gerrard left Melwood on Friday and will depart permanently at the end of the season. This season, questions have been raised about Gerrard’s longevity and whether he still belongs at the highest level. Yet it was notable that Liverpool delivered one of their best Premier League performances—beating Swansea 4–1—without him on the pitch. Do not be misled: Gerrard remains vital to Liverpool, both on and off the field. In his absence, there is no natural successor as captain, and—despite the talent of players like Daniel Sturridge and Raheem Sterling—no other marquee figure remains. Liverpool beat Swansea 4–1 on Monday, with Gerrard on the bench. He celebrated scoring against Leicester—one of his seven goals for the Reds this season. It is the first time in decades that Liverpool’s squad lacks a world-class star. Even during lean years, they had Robbie Fowler, Michael Owen, or Fernando Torres. Without Gerrard, the current team lacks that spark—and given how close they came to winning the league just eight months ago, this void is striking. Brendan Rodgers must now plan for a future without Gerrard. This is not the end of his Anfield project: Liverpool still have a talented manager and several strong players. But the fact that this great club has reached such a crossroad a year earlier than anticipated may be a regret they come to deeply feel.

Jaap Stam, Ruud van Nistelrooy, Roy Keane, na hata Cristiano Ronaldo, kwa namna fulani, wote walifunga Old Trafford wakati Ferguson na klabu yake walipata wakati wao. Je, Liverpool zinaweza kufikia upungufu wa kushindwa ambao utakuwa na matokeo ya kuchukua Steven Gerrard? Hii ni masuala. Kwa sasa, mchango wake unavyotaka kusaidia yeye zaidi kuliko Liverpool. Gerrard alidai kuwa amekuwa ameonekana ameifanya kazi kwa furaha baada ya kuziambia watu kwamba atakauka Liverpool mwishoni mwa mwezi wa juzi. Alizungumza kwa makala za kawaida Novemba. Je, hii imesababisha mchango wake? Yeye tu anajua, lakini mchango wake unazungumza kwa wingi kuhusu tamaa yake kuhusu uwezo wa Liverpool kwenye miaka mitano iliyofuata. Ikiwa Gerrard alikuwa ameaminika kwamba Rodgers atakuvuta Liverpool tena kwenye mapambano ya Premier League mwaka wa kwanza, ni dhidi ya kuchagua kuondoka. Kwa sababu, rafiki yake karibu Jamie Carragher amewahi kufanya hitilafu hiyo. Mchango wake kuendelea na chanzo nje ya nchi wakati miguu yake bado yanaweza kusaidia ni mfano wa tamaa yake kuhusu fursa za kundi la Rodgers kwenye kipindi cha karibu. Gerrard alifunga Melwood Jumapili na atakuja kuchukua kwa mwisho mwisho mwisho mwezi wa kwanza. Mwaka huu, maswali yamezuliwa kuhusu uzito wa Gerrard. Maswali yalikuwa yamepewa kuhusu uwezo wake katika daraja juu na ilikuwa muhimu kuona Liverpool kufanya moja ya maonyo bora zaidi ya Premier League—kushinda Swansea 4–1—sio na yeye kwenye kikosi. Usijihukumu: Gerrard bado ni muhimu kwa Liverpool, ndani na nje ya mazingira. Kwa ujumla, hakuna mmoja ambaye anaweza kubadilisha kiongozi, na—kwa kuwa na wachezaji kama Daniel Sturridge na Raheem Sterling—hakuna mchezaji mkuu ambaye bado amekaa. Liverpool walishtuka Swansea 4–1 Jumatatu, na Gerrard alikuwa kwenye bench. Alikuwa akishukuru kwa kushinda Leicester—moja ya malipo yake saba kwa Red kwa mwaka huu. Kwa mara ya kwanza kwa miaka mingi, kikosi cha Liverpool kinafanya kazi bila mchezaji wa dunia. Hata wakati wa miaka ya kutosha, walikuwa na Robbie Fowler, Michael Owen, au Fernando Torres. Bila Gerrard, kikosi hicho kinafanya kazi bila nuru—na kwa sababu walivyofanya kazi karibu na kushinda Premier League muda mrefu mbele, hili kifo ni kubwa. Brendan Rodgers lazima ajitegemea kwa siku za baadaye bila Gerrard. Hii si mwisho wa mradi wake wa Anfield: Liverpool bado wana meneja mwenye uwezo na wachezaji mizani. Lakini kwamba klabu hii kubwa imepata kipengele hiki miaka moja mapema kuliko mtazamo wowote, inaweza kusababisha hasira.

article_content: Republican presidential candidate Will Hurd spoke at the Iowa Faith and Freedom Coalition’s banquet on September 16, 2023, in Des Moines, Iowa. (Photo: Bryon Houlgrave/AP) WASHINGTON — Former Republican Texas Congressman Will Hurd suspended his presidential campaign on Monday and endorsed fellow GOP primary candidate Nikki Haley, officially ending a brief bid built on criticizing Donald Trump at a time when the Republican Party appears increasingly committed to embracing the former president. 'While I appreciate all the time and energy our supporters have given, it is important to recognize the realities of the political landscape and the need to consolidate our party around one person to defeat both Donald Trump and President Biden,' Hurd wrote on X, the platform formerly known as Twitter. He added that Haley — a former U.S. ambassador to the United Nations under Trump and former governor of South Carolina — 'has shown a willingness to articulate a different vision for the country than Donald Trump and has an unmatched grasp of the complexities of our foreign policy.' Hurd was the last major candidate to enter the already crowded Republican primary field, announcing his run in late June. He withdrew barely three months later after failing to gain traction as a pragmatic moderate who pledged to lead the party away from Trump’s 'Make America Great Again' movement. He failed to qualify for both the first GOP debate in Milwaukee in August and the second debate in Simi Valley, California, the following month. 'America is at a crossroads, and it’s time to come together and make Joe Biden a one-term president,' Haley wrote on X in response to Hurd’s endorsement. 'Thank you, @WillHurd, for your support and confidence. We have a country to save!' Hurd’s exit follows that of Miami Mayor Francis Suarez, who became the first presidential hopeful to suspend his campaign after failing to qualify for the first debate. Hurd was excluded from the Milwaukee event after falling short of the Republican National Committee’s minimum requirements for polling support and campaign donations. Initially, Hurd defended his exclusion, arguing that the RNC blocked him for refusing to sign a pledge committing to support the eventual nominee — even if it was Trump. 'The RNC standards are arbitrary, unclear, and lack consistency. This is an unacceptable process for a presidential election,' he said in a statement. After missing the second debate, Hurd adopted a more somber tone, writing on X: 'We narrowly missed the cut for the second debate, and our campaign is at an inflection point.' A former clandestine CIA officer who worked in Pakistan, Hurd served three terms in the House until January 2021 and was the chamber’s only Black Republican during his final two years in office. He represented Texas’ 23rd Congressional District — once the most competitive in the state — a heavily Hispanic region stretching over 800 miles along the Texas-Mexico border from near San Antonio to El Paso. Hurd chose not to seek reelection in 2020, stating he wanted to pursue opportunities outside Congress 'to solve problems at the nexus between technology and national security.' Last year, he toured the country promoting his book, 'American Reboot: An Idealist’s Guide to Getting Big Things Done.' The 46-year-old has long been a vocal critic of Trump, even urging him to withdraw from the 2016 race after the release of the 'Access Hollywood' tape, in which Trump boasted about sexually assaulting women. Hurd hoped to appeal to voters seeking a pro-business Republican with deep national security credentials who was also open to bipartisan compromise. In his campaign launch video, he criticized both Biden and Trump, accusing Biden of failing to secure the U.S.-Mexico border, combat fentanyl smuggling — which has fueled a nationwide overdose epidemic — and address rising violent crime and homelessness. 'President Biden can’t solve these problems — or won’t,' Hurd said. 'And if we nominate a lawless, selfish, failed politician like Donald Trump — who lost the House, the Senate, and the White House — we all know Joe Biden will win again.' As Trump faced multiple criminal indictments — now totaling four cases and 91 charges — Hurd intensified his public criticism. Yet Trump retained a commanding lead in early polls and fundraising. Hurd’s most memorable moments as a candidate came when he was heckled by Republican crowds for asserting that Trump would lose to Biden in a general election. At a July GOP dinner in Iowa, Hurd declared: 'Donald Trump is running to stay out of prison.' When met with sustained booing, he replied: 'Listen, I know the truth is hard.'

(Picha: Bryon Houlgrave/AP) WASHINGTON — Mwanachama mkuu wa Jamhuri wa Texas, Will Hurd, alifuta usimamizi wake wa rais tarehe Jumapili na kuweka msaada wake kwa mshiriki wake wa kuzingatia kwa GOP, Nikki Haley, kwa hivyo kuchukua nchi ya kampeni yake ya muda mfupi iliyobuniwa kwa kushindana na Donald Trump wakati uchaguzi wa jamhuri inaonekana kuwa na uaminifu zaidi kwa rais mpya. 'Nami ninafurahi kwa wakati na nguvu zote zilizotolewa na wapiga kura wetu, ni muhimu kuelewa hali ya nchi na mahitaji ya kusambaza chama yetu juu ya mtu mmoja ili kushinda Donald Trump na Rais Biden,' Hurd alisema kwenye X, chombo ambacho lilikuwa cha zamani Twitter. Aliongeza kwamba Haley — ambaye alikuwa ambasadi wa Marekani kwa Umoja wa Mataifa wakati wa Trump na waziri mkuu wa South Carolina — 'ameonyesha uwezo wa kutoa miongozo mengine kwa nchi kuliko Donald Trump na kufikia uwezo wa kuzingatia mabadiliko ya siasa yetu ya nje.' Hurd alikuwa mwanachama mkuu wa mwisho aliyeingia katika nchi ya kuzingatia ya GOP iliyokuwa tajiri, akianza kampeni yake mwezi wa Juni. Alipofuta kampeni yake baada ya masaa miwili tu, kwa sababu hakikweli kushinda mchanganyiko kama mwanachama wa kati ambaye alitaka kuleta chama kidogo kuingilia uongo wa 'Make America Great Again' wa Trump. 'Amerika iko kwenye misingi ya kuchagua, na wakati wa kujamii na kufanya Joe Biden rais mmoja tu,' Haley alisema kwenye X kujibu msaada wa Hurd. 'Asante, @WillHurd, kwa msaada wako na amani. Tuna nchi ya kudumisha!' Kufuta kampeni ya Hurd imekuwa baada ya mwanachama mwingine wa Jamhuri, Mkuu wa Miami Francis Suarez, ambaye alikuwa mwanachama wa kwanza wa rais ambaye alifuta kampeni yake baada ya kushindwa kuzingatia mashindano ya kwanza. Hurd hakuridhishi kwenye kumbukumbu ya Milwaukee kwa sababu hakikweli kufikia mara kwa mara ya Komiti ya Jamhuri ya Amerika kwa uwezo wa michango na idadi ya wapiga kura. Awali, Hurd alibadilisha kuzingatia, akisema kwamba RNC ilikuwa imezima kwa sababu alikataa kushiriki amri ya kushiriki mshiriki wa kuzingatia, hata ikiwa alikuwa Trump. 'Maradirisho ya RNC ni mabaya, isiyo wazi, na haikweli. Hii ni mchakato usio na uaminifu kwa uchaguzi wa rais,' alisema kwenye taarifa. Baada ya kushindwa kuzingatia mashindano ya pili, Hurd alikuwa na mchanganyiko mwingine, akisema kwenye X: 'Tunashindwa kufikia kufikia mashindano ya pili na kampeni yetu iko kwenye misingi ya kuchagua.' Mwanachama wa CIA ambaye alikuwa amefanya kazi nchini Pakistan, Hurd alihudhuria makambi mitatu katika Bunge hadi Januari 2021 na alikuwa mwanachama wa Jamhuri wa pekee wa Ndege wa Bunge wakati wa miaka miwili ya mwisho wake. Alikuwa amewakilisha mikoa ya 23 ya Texas — iliyokuwa ya kipekee zaidi nchini — eneo la kikuu la Hispania linalopita zaidi ya 800 maili ya mbingu ya Texas-Mexico kutoka karibu na San Antonio hadi El Paso. Hurd aliamua kumaliza kushiriki katika uchaguzi wa 2020, akisema alitaka kujifunza nje ya Bunge 'kutatua matatizo kwenye misingi ya teknolojia na usalama wa kitaifa.' Mwaka uliopita, alisafiri nchini kuzingatia kitabu chake, 'American Reboot: An Idealist’s Guide to Getting Big Things Done.' Mwanamke wa 46 mwaka, amekuwa mshiriki mkubwa wa Trump, hata akitoa msaada kwake kuchukua nchi ya kampeni ya 2016 baada ya kutoa 'Access Hollywood' tape ambapo Trump alisema kuwa ameshindwa kuharamu wanawake. Hurd alitaka kukuza wapiga kura ambao wanataka mwanachama wa Jamhuri wa biashara na uwezo wa usalama wa kitaifa ambaye pia awe na uwezo wa kushirikiana kwa kushirikiana. Katika video yake ya kuanza kampeni, alishindana na Biden na Trump, akisema kwamba rais hakuweza kuhifadhi mbingu ya Amerika-Mexico, kuzuia uhamasishaji wa fentanyl ambao umefanya ugonjwa wa kifo wa kifahari na uchovu wa kijamii na mazingira ya miji. 'Rais Biden hawezi kutatua matatizo haya — au hawapendi,' Hurd alisema katika video yake ya kuanza. 'Na kama tunaweka mwanachama mwenye dhati, mwenye tabia ya kudumu, mwanachama ambaye ameshindwa — ambaye ameshindwa Bunge, Seneti, na Nyumba ya Kifalme — tunajua kwamba Joe Biden ataendelea kupata kifalme.' Wakati Trump alikuwa amepigwa kwa makosa mengi — sasa 91 makosa kwa makundi miwili — Hurd alizidi kushindana na Trump. Lakini Trump bado ana mizani ya kuzingatia na mafanikio ya kushirikiana. Mashindano ya Hurd ya kipekee kama mwanachama wa nyumba ya kifalme yalikuwa wakati alikabiliwa na vikundi vya Jamhuri kwa kusema kwamba Trump atashindwa na Biden katika uchaguzi wa kawaida. Katika mkutano wa GOP mwezi wa Juli huko Iowa, Hurd alisema: 'Donald Trump anashiriki ili kuuza nyumba yake.' Wakati alipokabiliwa na maonyo, alijibu: 'Sikiliza, ninajua kwamba kweli ni ngumu.'

article_content: Seven years after being let go by England, former coach Duncan Fletcher still carries visible resentment — and it spilled over during a recent MCC event at Lord’s. When the Indian team arrived for the traditional post-match drinks reception, they left before England’s squad even showed up. Fletcher, who has never hidden his frustration with the ECB following England’s 2006–07 Ashes whitewash and subsequent World Cup exit, told his players to keep their visit brief. As a result, MCC president Mike Gatting cut short his welcome speech to accommodate the early departure. By the time England arrived — still celebrating Gary Ballance’s century — Gatting had to give a second speech. Fletcher has also raised formal objections with MCC over spectators standing too close behind bowlers during India’s innings. Meanwhile, ECB officials believe Fletcher may have encouraged India’s official ICC complaint over the Jimmy Anderson-Ravindra Jadeja confrontation at Trent Bridge. Outside cricket, hotel rates near St Andrews are soaring ahead of the 2015 Open, with some charging £400 per night and demanding week-long stays, driven by demand from U.S. and Japanese fans. In Brazil, Jaime Byrom is fighting to clear his British brother-in-law, Ray Whelan, who remains jailed in Rio’s Bangu prison over allegations of reselling £450,000 in hospitality tickets to a known tout. Byrom insists Whelan is innocent, but Brazilian authorities remain unconvinced. On the media front, Shane Warne continues to publicly criticize England captain Alastair Cook, yet the MCC has honored him by displaying his plastercast from a broken hand in their museum — a gesture many find odd, especially since Warne blames fellow Australian Brett Lee for the injury. Despite a string of poor results, England’s leadership is in flux: the managing director, chief selector, commercial director, and HR head have all exited. Yet Andy Flower, who once led England to glory, quietly remains in charge of elite coaching at Loughborough. As for Cook and coach Peter Moores, few expect them to survive the summer. In sports administration, Jackie Brock-Doyle, a seasoned communications expert, was quickly appointed to lead media operations for the Commonwealth Games after the previous chief fell ill. And in golf, Guy Kinnings of IMG is being heavily considered to replace retiring R&A CEO Peter Dawson — though with IMG’s new American owners pushing hard for golf growth, Kinnings may need significant incentives to leave his current role.

Wakati timu ya India ilikuja kwa chakula cha kawaida baada ya mchezo, walileta kabla ya timu ya Uingereza kuja. Fletcher pia amewapa MCC makubaliano ya kufanya shida kwa wapiga piga kwenye miguu ya mchezaji wa India. Hata hivyo, waziri wa ECB wanadhani kwamba Fletcher amewaangaza India kwa shida rasmi ya ICC kuhusu mchakato wa Jimmy Anderson na Ravindra Jadeja huko Trent Bridge. Nje ya kriketi, bei za nyumba za kijiji karibu na St Andrews zimeongezeka sana kwa ajili ya Open ya 2015, baadhi ya kutoa £400 kwa usiku na kuingiza mwezi mmoja, kwa sababu ya taka za Marekani na Japan. Byrom anasema kwamba Whelan ni mzima, lakini polisi za Brazil hazijui. Kwenye mazingira ya habari, Shane Warne anaendelea kudai kwa kibinadamu kapteni wa Uingereza Alastair Cook, lakini MCC amewaonya kikulio cha mkono wake wa kusimama kwenye muonzo wa michezo ya 200 ya Lord’s — mchango ambao wengine wanaonekana kama kibinadamu, hasa kwa sababu Warne anadhani kwamba Brett Lee alikuwa mshirika. Na katika kriketi, Guy Kinnings wa IMG anafikiriwa kuwa mchaguo mkuu wa kubadilisha Mkuu wa R&A, Peter Dawson, ambaye atapita baada ya Open ya 2015 — lakini kwa sababu wa waziri mpya wa IMG wanafanya kazi kwa kikombe cha kriketi, Kinnings anahitaji makubaliano mengi kuelekea.

article_content: A former star college quarterback, Cullen Finnerty, was found dead in northern Michigan on Tuesday night, two days after going missing during a solo fishing trip, Grand Valley State University confirmed. His body was discovered near Baldwin, Michigan, following an extensive search led by local police, firefighters, state troopers, and dozens of university alumni—including former teammates, current students, and staff. Finnerty, a native of Brighton, Michigan, had left on Sunday to fish in Lake County, between Traverse City and Grand Rapids. He was last heard from Sunday evening. His family owns a cabin near the area where he vanished. The only significant clue in the investigation was the discovery of his small pontoon boat, stranded on the rocky shore of Bray Creek, near the Baldwin River. Video from CNN affiliate WTOM captured the vessel resting on the waterway. Sheriff Robert Hilts stated no foul play was suspected. Search teams, coordinated with Finnerty’s family, included members of the Lake County Sheriff’s Office, regional fire departments, and the Michigan State Police. At Grand Valley State, where Finnerty played from 2003 to 2006, he became a legend: compiling a 36-4 record, winning three Division II national titles, and leading the team to 28 straight victories. He was ranked No. 1 in 23 consecutive polls and named Division II Player of the Decade for the 2000s by D2football.com. His head coach at the time, Brian Kelly, now leads Notre Dame. After college, Finnerty joined the Baltimore Ravens’ practice squad in 2007 and was briefly promoted to the active roster. He also had a short stint with the Denver Broncos in 2008, though he never appeared in a regular-season NFL game. Finnerty is survived by his wife and two young children. Coach Jim Schaak, who participated in Tuesday’s search, shared with WTOM that Finnerty was not only a gifted athlete but a beloved friend and mentor to many.
translated_content: Mtu mwenye kipawa wa kucheza mpira wa miguu wa chuo kikuu cha zamani, Cullen Finnerty, amekufa nchini Michigan ya Kaskazini jumapili usiku, baada ya muda wa siku mbili alipokwenda kushika samaki kwa muda mrefu, Chuo Kikuu cha Grand Valley imethibitisha. Jasadake lilipatikana karibu na Baldwin, Michigan, baada ya utafiti mkubwa uliowekwa na polisi, maji ya moto, na wafanyakazi wa chuo kikuu na wengine wengi — waliojikita wengine wanaotembelea, wanafunzi wa sasa, na wafanyakazi. Finnerty, mtu kutoka Brighton, Michigan, alipokuja Jumamosi kushika samaki katika Lake County, kati ya Traverse City na Grand Rapids. Alipotazama kwa mwisho Jumamosi jioni. Familia yake ina kienyeji karibu na mahali ambapo aliyeacha. Njia moja ya kutosha katika utafiti ilikuwa kupata mvuti wake mdogo wa kichwani, uliopewa kwenye mto Bray Creek, karibu na Mto Baldwin. Video kutoka WTOM, chuo kikuu cha CNN, ilisaidia kuona mvuti huo uliopewa kwenye mto. Mkuu wa polisi Robert Hilts amesema hakuna uwezekano wa kuzima kwa njia ya dhambi. Timu za utafiti, zilizohusiana na familia ya Finnerty, zilikuwa na wanachama wa Ofisi ya Polisi ya Lake County, timu za maji ya moto, na Polisi ya Nchi ya Michigan. Kwa Chuo Kikuu cha Grand Valley, ambapo Finnerty alicheza kati ya 2003 na 2006, ameleta kipato: kuchukua rekodi ya 36-4, kufuzu tatu kwa kicheko cha kwanza cha Division II, na kufanya timu yake kushinda 28 mchezo kwa mpaka. Aliwa kati ya 23 kauli za kufanana kwa kila mchezo, na kuchaguliwa mwanachama wa kushinda kwa miaka 2000 na D2football.com. Mtu aliyekuwa meneja wake wakati huo, Brian Kelly, sasa anaendesha Notre Dame. Baada ya chuo, Finnerty alijiunga na kikoa cha kujifunza cha Baltimore Ravens mwaka 2007, na kushiriki kwa muda mfupi katika timu ya kawaida. Pia alikuwa na muda mfupi na Denver Broncos mwaka 2008, lakini hakutamka katika mchezo wowote wa kawaida ya NFL. Finnerty amekuwa na mke wake na watoto wawili. Meneja Jim Schaak, ambaye alishiriki katika utafiti wa Jumapili, amesema kwa WTOM kuwa Finnerty alikuwa si bora tu kwa mpira wa miguu, bali ni rafiki na msaidizi wa kipekee kwa wengine.

article_content: Two brothers, Roger Cooper, 40, of Coventry, and David Cooper, 38, of Leicester, have been charged with the murder of Sameena Imam, who disappeared on Christmas Eve. Sameena Imam, a 34-year-old woman known to many friends as Sam, was last seen at approximately 4 p.m. on December 24 at the Costco warehouse in Coventry, where she worked, according to West Midlands Police. Her black BMW was discovered 65 miles away in Luton, Bedfordshire, on January 4. Despite extensive searches, no trace of Ms. Imam has been found. She lived in Cardiff. Three days after her disappearance, the brothers were arrested at their respective homes and have remained in custody since. They were formally charged yesterday, and police have conducted searches at both of their residences. Authorities have also searched areas of grassland, a brook, and a park in Leicester in an effort to locate evidence related to the case. Detective Superintendent Mark Payne of West Midlands Police described the murder charges as 'a significant development' in the investigation and expressed condolences to Ms. Imam’s family. The brothers are scheduled to appear at Birmingham Crown Court to face the charges.
translated_content: Wawili wa kiume, Roger Cooper, 40, kutoka Coventry, na David Cooper, 38, kutoka Leicester, wamechukuliwa kwa mapenzi ya kufa kwa Sameena Imam ambaye ilihodhuliwa kwa usiku wa Krismasi. Sameena Imam, mwanamke wa miaka 34 ambaye wengi wanaita Sam, alikuwa ameonesha mara ya mwisho kwa takwimu 4 mchana tarehe 24 Desemba katika store ya Costco nchini Coventry, kwa mujibu wa Polisi ya West Midlands. Gari lake la nyeupe BMW lilipatikana kwenye umbali wa 65 maili kutoka Luton, Bedfordshire tarehe 4 Januari. Kwa upande wa kusudi wa kujifunza, hakuna taarifa yoyote ya Ms. Imam. Alikuwa amekaa Cardiff. Baada ya siku tatu za kuhodhuliwa, wawili waliohodhuliwa walipigwa mkono nyumbani zao na wamebaki kwenye udhalimu hadi sasa. Wamechukuliwa jana, na polisi wamefanya utafiti katika makazi yao wote wawili. Watawala wamefanya utafiti katika eneo la kijani, kinywani, na parki nchini Leicester kwa lengo la kupata adhabu za suala hilo. Mkuu wa Polisi Mark Payne wa West Midlands alisema kuwa chakula cha mapenzi ni 'maendeleo muhimu' katika utafiti na kumtuma tabasamu kwa familia ya Ms. Imam. Wawili watakuja kwenye Kikosi cha Kikuu cha Birmingham kuchukuliwa.

article_content: Ahead of London Fashion Week, TV presenter and designer Fearne Cotton unveiled her 16th collection for Very.co.uk — a playful SS15 line inspired by the circus, stepping away from her 60s-themed AW14 range. At a sunlit photocall in London, she wore a hot pink mini dress from the collection, paired with fishnet tights, and styled two models in dipped-hem dresses. Attendees included her mother-in-law Jo Wood in a flouncy shirt and jade green blazer, along with friends Lucy Watson and Stephanie Pratt, dressed in summery tones. The full collection launches online on January 13th, but an exclusive runway video offers fans a first look. Very.co.uk emphasizes that Fearne’s designs have become beloved for blending bold style with affordable pricing. The brand says its goal is to help customers feel confident and stylish every day — and this season’s circus-inspired collection delivers exactly that: fun, fearless, and full of flair.

article_content: Pressure mounted on Nick Clegg to step down as leader of the Liberal Democrats after the party suffered a crushing defeat in the 2014 European elections. The Lib Dems lost all but one of their MEPs, dropping to fifth place behind Ukip, the Conservatives, Labour, and the Green Party. In an emotional interview, Clegg described the result as 'gutting and heartbreaking,' admitting his party had lost the argument over Europe. His eyes appeared bloodshot as he spoke from Lib Dem headquarters in London. Amid the turmoil, former Prime Minister Tony Blair offered unexpected support, commending Clegg’s 'courage and leadership' for confronting Ukip head-on through televised debates. However, Blair warned that the Lib Dems’ deeper problem lay not in Europe, but in their broken promise on tuition fees — having campaigned against them in 2010, then supporting a tripling under the Conservative-led coalition. Meanwhile, Ukip leader Nigel Farage publicly thanked Clegg for giving his campaign momentum, saying the debates 'kicked off the whole European election campaign.' Leaked polling, reportedly commissioned by a Lib Dem activist, suggested Clegg could lose his Sheffield Hallam seat to Labour by a wide margin in the next general election — along with other key constituencies like Cambridge and Redcar. The Lib Dem party dismissed the poll as politically motivated and inaccurate, clarifying that in the actual European vote, Labour received 38.7% in Sheffield Hallam, while the Lib Dems earned just 18.5% — placing them fifth behind Ukip, Labour, the Tories, and the Greens. Calls for Clegg’s resignation grew louder, with reports suggesting 12 MPs were prepared to demand his exit. Some, like John Pugh, compared continuing under his leadership to 'generals at the Somme' — clinging to failed strategy amid catastrophic losses. Business Secretary Vince Cable, seen as a potential successor, denied any leadership challenge was underway. He praised Clegg for standing up to the 'eurosceptic wave' sweeping Europe and urged unity within the party. Senior Conservatives began quietly assessing how the coalition might survive without Clegg — potentially transitioning to a 'confidence and supply' agreement, where the Lib Dems would support the government only on budget and confidence votes, while retaining freedom on other policies. In his own constituency of Sheffield, Clegg faced the full force of voter anger — with the Lib Dems finishing fifth. Similar patterns emerged in Doncaster, where Labour trailed Ukip. Meanwhile, in West Oxfordshire, Prime Minister David Cameron held off Ukip’s challenge in his own seat. Former Tory Chancellor Ken Clarke argued the Lib Dems had lost their identity as a protest party — having joined government, they lost left-leaning voters to Labour and right-leaning ones to Ukip. Former Lib Dem president Des Wilson called Clegg 'politically toxic' and urged him to step down as party leader — though remain Deputy PM.
translated_content: Kuweka mkakati mwingi kwa Nick Clegg kuondoka kama mkuu wa Demokrasi ya Liberales baada ya kushindwa kubwa katika uchaguzi wa Ulaya wa 2014. Lib Dems zilipoteza majengo yote yote isipokuwa moja, kushuka kwenye nafasi ya tano chini ya Ukip, Konservativu, Labour, na Chama cha Wakhristo. Katika mazungumzo ya kisikukuu, Clegg alisema matokeo yalikuwa 'ya kugusa na ya kuchoka,' akisema jambo la kusudi lililoshindwa kuhusu Ulaya. Macho yake yalikuwa yamejaa damu wakati alivyowezesha kwenye kifedha cha Lib Dem nchini London. Kati ya uchovu, Mkuu wa zamani Tony Blair alitoa msaada unaotokana na kusudi, akikaribisha Clegg kwa 'udhibiti na uongozi' wake kwa kushughulikia Ukip kwa kinyume. Hata hivyo, Blair alisema kwamba tatizo kuu la Lib Dems haijengwa kuhusu Ulaya, bali kwa sababu ya maneno yao ya kutosha kuhusu malipo ya elimu — walivyofanya kazi dhidi yake mnamo 2010, kisha kushiriki kwenye serikali ya Konservativu ambayo ilizidisha malipo kwa mara tatu. Kwa upande mwingine, Mkuu wa Ukip Nigel Farage alitoa shukrani kwa Clegg kwa kutoa mshale kwa kampeni yake, akisema majadiliano ya televisheni iliyosababisha 'kuanzisha kampeni yote ya uchaguzi wa Ulaya.' Majadiliano ya kilele, yanayosema kuwa yamefanywa na mwanachama wa Lib Dem, yalielezea kwamba Clegg aweza kupoteza sehemu yake ya Sheffield Hallam kwa Labour kwa nambari kubwa katika uchaguzi wa kawaida — pamoja na makao makuu mengine kama Cambridge na Redcar. Kikundi cha Lib Dem kilichukua matokeo kama za kisiasa na sitaki, akisema kuwa katika uchaguzi wa Ulaya, Labour ilipata 38.7% katika Sheffield Hallam, wakati Lib Dems ilipata tu 18.5% — kushuka kwenye nafasi ya tano chini ya Ukip, Labour, Konservativu, na Wakhristo. Mashauri ya kuingiza Clegg kuondoka zilizong'oa, na makumbusho ya kwamba 12 wabunge walikuwa tayari kuitaka kuondoka. Baadhi, kama John Pugh, walikipa kufuatilia mamlaka kama 'waziri wa Somme' — kuchukua mbinu zilizoshindwa kati ya matukio ya kubwa. Waziri wa Biashara Vince Cable, ambaye anakuwa mkuu wa kina, alikataa kila mashauri ya kubadilisha mkuu. Alikaribisha Clegg kwa kushughulikia 'mawasiliano ya kuvunjika ya Ulaya' na kuomba uamuzi wa kikundi. Wabunge wa Konservativu walianzisha kuchambua jinsi serikali iweza kubaki bila Clegg — kwa kubadilisha kwa mchakato wa 'thibitisho na mipango' ambapo Lib Dems itasaidia serikali tu kwenye viti vya fedha na thibitisho, na kubaki na uhuru kwenye masuala mengine. Katika sehemu yake ya Sheffield, Clegg alisikia nguvu ya kusisimua kwa wapiga kura — wakati Lib Dems zilishuka kwenye nafasi ya tano. Matokeo ya kawaida yalikuwa katika Doncaster, ambapo Labour ilishinda Ukip. Hata hivyo, West Oxfordshire, David Cameron alikabiliana na kushinda Ukip katika sehemu yake. Waziri wa Fedha wa zamani Ken Clarke alisema Lib Dems zilipoteza utambulisho wao kama chama cha kushughulikia — kwa kushiriki serikali, zilipoteza wapiga kura wa kushoto kwa Labour na wa kulia kwa Ukip. Mkuu wa zamani wa Lib Dem Des Wilson alisema Clegg ni 'takrima ya kisiasa' na 'hakuna kipawa' na kuitaka kuondoka kama mkuu wa chama — lakini kubaki kama Waziri Mkuu wa Pili.

article_content: In a thrilling, three-and-a-half-hour battle under the lights of Rod Laver Arena, Rafael Nadal overcame a gritty Roger Federer to reach the Australian Open final. After dropping the first set in a tight tiebreak, Nadal won the next three sets 6-2, 7-6(5), 6-4 to seal a 6-7(5), 6-2, 7-6(5), 6-4 victory. The win marks his 18th triumph over Federer in their storied rivalry — and his eighth in Grand Slam showdowns. For Nadal, this moment felt surreal. Just weeks earlier, he’d been in tears, convinced his body wouldn’t hold up for the tournament. 'I thought I wouldn’t even play,' he admitted. 'Now I’m in the final? It’s a dream.' His emotional comeback story added weight to what was already a classic clash. Federer, aiming for his 17th major, had dominated without dropping a set through five matches — until Thursday. He saved a match point but couldn’t sustain his rhythm. Even a pause for Australia Day fireworks midway through the second set failed to slow Nadal’s momentum; he won 11 straight points during that stretch. Despite the loss, Federer remained gracious. 'We’ve had incredible battles over the years,' he said. 'He always seems to raise his game when we play — and honestly, that’s what makes these matches special.' Their mutual admiration shone through, even as the crowd roared for every shot. Nadal now awaits the winner of Djokovic vs. Murray — a final that could define his season. For now, he’s savoring a win that defied all odds — and reminded everyone why tennis fans still hold this rivalry sacred.
translated_content: Katika mshindo unaofanya kila mtu akifika kwa moyo, Rafael Nadal alifanikiwa kushinda Roger Federer kwa njia ya kuchukua nafasi katika mchezo wa mwisho wa Australian Open. Baada ya kupoteza sehemu ya kwanza katika tiebreak, Nadal alishinda sehemu tatu zilizofuata kwa matokeo ya 6-2, 7-6(5), 6-4, kushinda mchezo kwa matokeo ya 6-7(5), 6-2, 7-6(5), 6-4. Mshindo huu ulikuwa ni mapema yake ya kumi na kumi na kwanza dhidi ya Federer, na kumi na wili katika mashindano ya Grand Slam. Kwa Nadal, hii ilikuwa kipindi cha kisiasa. Muda mrefu kabla ya mchezo, alikuwa ameangalia kwa macho yake na kusema kuwa hakuna nafasi yake kushiriki. 'Nilisikia kuwa sikupata fursa ya kushiriki,' alisema. 'Na sasa niko katika mchezo wa mwisho? Ni kipawa!' Kipindi chake cha kurejea kwa kushinda ulionyesha uzoefu wake wa kipekee. Federer, ambaye alitaka kushinda kipawa chake cha kumi na saba, alikuwa ameshinda kila sehemu katika michezo miwili makuu kabla ya Jumatatu. Alikuwa ameongea mshindo wa kushinda, lakini hakufanikiwa kudumisha mtindo wake. Hatimaye, mshindo wa Australia Day uliweza kuzuia mchango wa Nadal; alishinda matokeo ya 11 kwa mpaka mmoja. Bila kushindwa, Federer alibaki na huruma. 'Tunajenga michezo mazuri sana kwa muda mrefu,' alisema. 'Akiwa na mchango zaidi wakati tunapopiga — na hii ndio inayokuwa na maana kwa michezo haya.' Ustadi wao wa kusudiwa ulionyesha, hata wakati watu waliosikia kila piga. Nadal sasa anawaita mshindi wa Djokovic vs. Murray — mchezo ambao unaweza kuelezea mchakato wake. Sasa, anashukuru mshindo ambao uliweza kushinda kila taka — na kusikiliza kwa wengine kuwa ni mchezo ambao utabaki kwa milele.

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) — 'No matter what I do in life, I think I will always be remembered as the wrap dress,' said Diane von Furstenberg in a 2008 CNN interview. A Belgian-born, New York-based designer and former member of the German nobility, daughter of a Holocaust survivor, von Furstenberg achieved global fame for one garment: the wrap dress. Made of soft jersey and fastened like a kimono, this simple yet elegant design sold in the millions during the 1970s — becoming a powerful emblem of feminism and the sexual revolution. 'I was selling clothes that would make other women feel confident,' she recalled. Von Furstenberg herself became the face of her brand, famously photographed wearing her own creations — so much so that Andy Warhol painted her portrait. Yet rapid success led to over-licensing in the 1980s, diluting the brand’s identity. 'The spirit of the brand disappeared,' she admitted. By the late 1990s, the wrap dress returned to fashion, and DVF made a historic comeback — now recognized as one of the most successful fashion revivals of the decade. Today, with 30 boutiques and numerous department store concessions, DVF is a multi-million-dollar empire. She dresses stars like Madonna and Sharon Stone, yet keeps her pieces accessible and designed for effortless elegance. 'When a woman walks into a DVF shop and tries something on, it's like a light turns on,' she said. Celebrities such as Eva Longoria Parker praise her not just as a designer, but as a person. Honored by the CFDA with the presidency, von Furstenberg is widely regarded as the Grand Dame of New York fashion. In 2008, CNN followed her as she prepared for the CFDA Awards — where, in a moving tribute to her late friend Yves Saint Laurent, she abandoned her own design to wear a tuxedo by YSL. 'He brought art into fashion, and fashion into art,' she told CNN. 'He used to joke he wanted to be Matisse. But I think if Matisse could have chosen, he’d have wanted to be Yves Saint Laurent.' Later that year, von Furstenberg made her European runway debut in a moonlit garden in Florence — the city near where her first wrap dress was originally manufactured. The collection, 'Le Petit Valise,' featured travel-ready, wrinkle-free ensembles inspired by 'The Talented Mr. Ripley.' Six hundred guests, including Lapo Elkann of the Fiat dynasty, witnessed 50 wardrobe changes as models portrayed a young American adventuring abroad. Behind-the-scenes footage captured the emotional and joyful moments: fittings, rehearsals, and even the presence of her 9-year-old granddaughter, whom von Furstenberg affectionately calls 'my assistant.' The event was more than a show — it was a homecoming. Tune in to CNN International’s 'Revealed' in November for the full story.

Mwanamke wa Belgium, anayekaa New York, mwanamke wa familia ya Ujerumani, mtoto wa mgeni wa Holocaust, von Furstenberg amepata shuhuda duniani kwa kile kitu chake: kando la 'wrap'. Iliyotengenezwa na kofia ya jersey na kushikwa kama kimono, kando hiki limekua na idadi kubwa ya milioni katika miaka ya 1970 — kuweka kama ishara ya kifeministi na mapinduzi ya sekso. 'Nimesimama kwa nguo ambazo zinaweza kufanya wanawake wengine wacheze,' alisema. Von Furstenberg yenyewe ilikuwa mwanamke wa bendi yake, imepiga picha na nguo zake zake — hata hivyo Andy Warhol alipiga picha yake. Lakini shuhuda ya haraka ilieleza kwa kutoa ruhusa kwa bidhaa nyingi katika miaka ya 1980, kuzima roho ya bendi. 'Roho ya bendi ilizima,' alisema. Katika miaka ya 1990, kando la 'wrap' lilirudi kwenye fasheni, na DVF ilirudi kwenye viti vya fasheni, na kisha kwenye mapigano ya fasheni. Kupitia kwa kipindi hicho kimeshikwa kama moja ya historia bora zaidi za biashara za miaka hiyo. Leo, na 30 duka na mifumo mingi katika dukani, DVF ni biashara ya miliioni ya dola. Anapiga wanamke kama Madonna na Sharon Stone, lakini inabaki na bei rahisi na utaratibu wa 'nguo rahisi kukuwa'. 'Wakati mwanamke anapokuja duka la DVF na kujaribu kitu, ni kama mwanga unafungua,' alisema. Wanamke wa kipekee kama Eva Longoria Parker wanapong'aa yeye si tu mwanafasheni, bali mtu. Imekuwa amekuwa na uongozi wa CFDA, von Furstenberg amekuwa amekuwa na jina la 'Grand Dame' ya fasheni ya New York. Mwaka 2008, CNN ilisoma yeye kwa wakati alipoandaa kwa CFDA Awards — ambapo, kwa tamaa ya kushukuru kwa rafiki yake aliyekufa, alipiga kando lake na kukuwa tuxedo ya Yves Saint Laurent. 'Amefanya sanaa kuwa fasheni, na fasheni kuwa sanaa,' alisema CNN. 'Alikuwa akisemea kwamba alitaka kuwa Matisse. Lakini ninaamini kama Matisse alipoweza kuchagua, aliyeenda kuwa Yves Saint Laurent.' Baadaye mwaka huo, von Furstenberg alipiga kando lake kwa mara ya kwanza nje ya Marekani, na mazingira ya kifalme cha kijiji cha Florence — mji ulio karibu na mahali ambapo kando la kwanza la 'wrap' lilitengenezwa. Koleksioni, 'Le Petit Valise,' ilikuwa na nguo zinazoweza kushughulikwa rahisi na hazikosa — neno linaloendelea na roho ya DVF. Mwisho mmoja na watu 600, ikiwa ni pamoja na Lapo Elkann wa familia ya Fiat, walionyesha 50 mabadiliko ya nguo kama wageni wa mwanamke wa Marekani aliyekwenda nje ya nchi. Kutoka kwenye kazi za kujaribu, mashabiki, na hatua ya kujifunza, kila kitu kilikuwa kipya na kibaya. Hata mke wa kiume wa miaka 9 ambaye von Furstenberg anaita 'msaidizi wangu,' ilikuwa pamoja. Kipindi hicho kilikuwa zaidi ya kando — ni kushughulikia nyumbani. Angalia 'Revealed' kwenye CNN International Novemba kwa historia kamili.
